verdict_rationale: All five confirmed defects (P-01 through P-05) identified in the Phase 4F.4.2 independent readiness audit have been resolved and thoroughly validated through offline regression testing. Cross-process atomic authorization locking guarantees single-use enforcement without race conditions. On-disk manifest byte-level SHA256 verification and single-parse execution eliminate TOCTOU tamper risks. Immutable container image reference pinning prevents mutable tag drift at container launch. Execution-ID namespaced artifact directories prevent collision and preserve historical evidence. Missing cgroup telemetry is preserved as UNAVAILABLE without synthetic 0.0 coercions. All 252 repository tests pass offline.

findings_resolved.title: Atomic Cross-Process Authorization Consumption
findings_resolved.implementation: Implemented CampaignAuthorizationRecord.consume_file_atomically() using fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX) on dedicated .lock file, holding lock across read, validation, expiration/revocation check, consumed update, fsync, and atomic tmp file replacement.

findings_resolved.title: Exact On-Disk Manifest Byte-Level Integrity & Single-Parse Execution
findings_resolved.implementation: Read raw manifest bytes once before preflight, compute SHA256 directly from bytes, verify against EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256 and auth_record.manifest_sha256, parse into verified_schedule, and execute directly from memory without re-reading from disk.

findings_resolved.title: Immutable Container Image Reference Pinning
findings_resolved.implementation: Configured TrialIsolationManager.initialize_fresh_container() and Phase4F4Runner to construct and pass immutable repository@digest reference (postgres@sha256:cf78e76683b9ca8c5733cbbdce6c9262b45b6767934dd0a95e671f9a0fc20685) directly to docker run.

findings_resolved.title: Execution-ID Namespaced Artifact Directories & Collision Protection
findings_resolved.implementation: Namespaced default artifacts root to artifacts/phase_4f4_empirical/{execution_id}, enforced non-empty directory reuse rejection, and maintained atomic latest symlink pointer.

findings_resolved.title: Telemetry Availability Preservation Without Default Substitution
findings_resolved.implementation: Removed all 'or 0.0' coercions for CPU throttling. Preserved None with status: 'UNAVAILABLE' and explicit reason in trial summaries, condition summaries, and comparison metrics.
